question: Should the remaining work be a Signal-specific media-only delivery fix, or a new cross-channel `messages` media-placeholder suppression setting?
rationale: Current main has already fixed iMessage locally, while Signal may need transport-specific handling and a global config knob is a product/config-surface choice under OpenClaw policy.

options.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
options.body: Keep defaults compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

options.title: Add global messages setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-off suppression option with schema, metadata, docs, and cross-channel tests if maintainers want user policy control.

options.title: Defer pending live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until live Signal proof shows which transport-safe replacement works best.

recommendation.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
recommendation.body: Keep defaults compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.
